name: TC-045: Verify Product Details Screen Layout and Information

steps.name: Precondition: User is on the Catalog screen
Step 2 & Verification: Observe the product details screen

testCase.name: TC-045: Verify Product Details Screen Layout and Information

descriptionHtml:
Preconditions:
    - User is on the Catalog screen.

Steps:
    1. Tap on "Sauce Labs Backpack".
    2. Observe the product details screen.

Expected Result:
    - The screen displays product title ("Sauce Labs Backpack"), price ("$ 29.99"),
      full description, product image, color selectors, and quantity controls.
